messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize what the inference sprint actually ships. three asks stacked up from customers: low-latency chat for ACME, 2x batch embeddings throughput for Atlas, and a 20% hosted cost reduction ask from finance. i want a tight prioritization (RICE-ish) + clear launch criteria. short takes?
liam: can we split into Parallel tracks? low-latency infra work (kv cache, faster kernel) vs throughput/batching (micro-batching, async workers). both touch runtime but different risk profiles.
sofia: +1 to two tracks. also need per-customer QoS: ACME needs p99 < 120ms for short-turn chat, Atlas needs sustained 5k reqs/min. cost ask is broad — could be mostly quantization + caching.
devon: customers will push for single roadmap item if we don't present a priority. suggest scoring each initiative with R/I/C/E numbers today and pick top 2.
natalie: infra constraints: we have 1 reserved pod team for the sprint. latency improvements need kernel engineering (risk: 2 weeks of regression hunting). batching can be async and landed incrementally.
kyle: don't forget SLO/rollback criteria. for latency changes we must have fallback to current model variant if p99 rises.
sofia: proposed mini-RICE template we can use quickly: 
```
Reach = expected requests impacted/day (estimate)
Impact = 0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 scale (customer severity)
Confidence = percent (0-100)
Effort = engineer-weeks
RICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
```
liam: i'll fill numbers for latency infra and batching by EOD. sofia + devon fill customer impact/confidence.
devon: quick poll: react with :zap: for latency-first, :fast_forward: for throughput-first, :moneybag: for cost-first. please do within 2 hours so PM can call it.
maya: tagging exec ask: if RICE is within 20% tie, we lean towards lower-regret (easier rollback) option. note for launch criteria: must include perf regression tests, canary duration, and perf budget.
natalie: pragmatic constraint — quantization work needs model owner signoff and offline evals (2-3 weeks). might not fit sprint unless we scope to config changes.
kyle: ops note: batching boosts throughput but raises tail latency risk for single-shot chat. we should ship batching behind a flag + per-route config.
sofia: also propose a small eval harness: 500 representative prompts (ACME set + Atlas batch mix) with automated scoring. pass/fail gates for merge.
liam: draft numbers: latency infra: Reach=30k/day, Impact=1.0, Confidence=60, Effort=6w => RICE~300k*? (we're using the formula above, will compute exact)
liam: batching: Reach=80k/day, Impact=0.6, Confidence=70, Effort=4w
devon: finance cost reduction: Reach=100k/day, Impact=0.4, Confidence=50, Effort=3w
maya: good — looks like batching + latency are contenders. we'll reconvene at 4pm with final scores. i'll draft the roll-forward/rollback checklist and release gates.
deploy-bot: canary window scheduled for latency-infra branch: 2026-03-20T20:00Z -> 2026-03-21T02:00Z (auto-monitoring enabled).
maya: final ask — when we pick top item, product will own launch criteria doc (perf targets, customer comms, A/B plan). devex please prepare quickstart for customers who want non-default routes.
devon: noted. i'll schedule customer pre-briefs for ACME + Atlas for acceptance criteria sign-off.
liam: filing the RICE spreadsheet now, will drop link in thread.
sofia: thanks. short and pragmatic — we need to avoid reflexively prioritizing the loudest ask.
maya: yes. two-track execution plan if numbers support it; single-track if RICE strongly favors one. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
